subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this issue, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but the open linked PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a safe duplicate repair lane; its stale check/proof state needs human handling.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile any path drift, and resolve stale check state.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Close or set aside the fork PR and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver fix with focused source and browser proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile any path drift, and resolve stale check state.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is closest to the channel UI metadata path and to whether the fork patch should be adopted or replaced.
